title: 日本ダービーの後に・完走、完勝！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket runs the incredible race of her dreams and emerges a champion. Cheers of "Tickezo" echo throughout the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Immensely satisfied that she was able to inspire her fans, she promises to deliver another heated race at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide congratulate Winning Ticket on her victory, but swear that they won't lose next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket bursts into uncontrollable tears, passionately thanking her rivals for their contributions to her victory.
